edit.description: `emit_program_runs_the_shipped_example_harness` (:2222) runs the example's program under `dry_run: true`, and `drift::emit_program` writes the lock only inside `if !options.dry_run` (`src/drift.rs:1550`) — so the assertion loop reads `report.entries`, which carry projections alone, and the committed `examples/base-harness/.temper/lock.toml` is reproduced by nothing.
